acceptance_criteria.criterion: Changes solely to review-request metadata should not repeat unrelated heavy suites if unchanged tested inputs can be proven identical, while review-request exact-head validation and independent review authority remain mandatory.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: scripts/hunter_validation_reuse.py computes a Git-blob-based tested-subtree digest (git ls-tree object IDs/modes/paths) excluding only .hunter/pre-ready-hostile-review.json, verifies 15 equivalence identities, and exposes verify_for_candidate, wired into hunter_preflight_reuse_decision.decide() for metadata-only diffs. scripts/hunter_ci_final_execution.py is only the standalone operator CLI/consumer. Reuse succeeds only with a new current-HEAD-bound decision referencing the immutable source proof; independent exact-head review is never bypassed. 22 tests in tests/test_hunter_ci_final_execution.py pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Run one final authoritative aggregate gate after candidate HEAD stabilizes; bind outcome to repo, PR, exact HEAD, run attempt, proof digest and trusted job, and never self-depend on an unpublished status.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: _source_proof_bindings lives inside the canonical authority module (hunter_validation_reuse) and derives run/attempt/job/digest using that module's own _canonical_job_proof and trusted_branch_preflight_run. No second proof authority or status publisher was introduced. EQUIVALENCE_IDENTITIES binds repository, PR, current head, source proof head, base, tested subtree, dependency/workflow/toolchain/environment identities, run attempt, trusted job, proof digest and provenance. No new self-dependent status context was added.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cancel or supersede obsolete runs on HEAD changes and protect against ABA changes, parallel pushes, stale successes, delayed callbacks, overlapping controllers, retry, cancellation and replayed status; an old HEAD must never authorize a newer HEAD.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Hostile regression tests in tests/test_preflight_reuse_decision.py exercise the real production selectors and decision functions for A→B while A runs, A→B→A, two overlapping controllers producing identical canonical outcomes, stale callbacks, over-deadline pending publication, cancelled runs, conflicting same-run/attempt API snapshots, newer-attempt precedence, rejected replayed digests and source/current head mismatch. Full focused set: 128 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Required GitHub checks always conclude rather than remaining pending because a workflow was skipped; no removal or weakening of rulesets or required checks, and no blanket disabling of heavy security validation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No .github workflow, ruleset, required context, signature or trusted boundary was modified. On uncertainty the metadata-only path returns a fail-closed refusal into a fresh full trusted run rather than a false success. Hosted check conclusions will be re-verified against the pushed HEAD.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Independent hostile review request must be fresh for the exact candidate and must not force unnecessary heavy retests; findings must be resolved and no reviewer authority self-certified.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The exact-head-bound .hunter/pre-ready-hostile-review.json is regenerated at commit time by the authorized writer finalizer from this fresh judgement for governing Issue #606 and the actual base-to-staged-head range, with all 11 adversarial dimensions and all applicable defect families recomputed from the diff. Findings is empty; no reviewer authority is asserted by the writer.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Provide a real hosted CI runtime/API measurement mechanism and record the measured BEFORE baseline, without asserting an unmeasured improvement, while preserving the authoritative security gate.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: collect_performance_evidence/performance_main in scripts/hunter_ci_final_execution.py measure real GitHub Actions run/job timestamps and count REST calls; missing timestamps are null, never invented. BEFORE baseline measured: 30 Hunter / Pre-PR Preflight runs, 31 REST requests, 21 successful, successful job duration median 828 s (range 617-1004 s), recorded in docs/CI_INCREMENTAL_EXECUTION.md. No AFTER improvement is claimed here; it is deferred to hosted verification of the pushed HEAD.

defect_families.evidence: Cross-HEAD reuse binds repository, PR, current HEAD, source proof HEAD, run, attempt, job and proof digest; a proof digested for a different head is rejected by tests/test_hunter_ci_final_execution.py, so an authorization cannot be replayed onto another operation or resulting content.

The tested-subtree digest is derived from Git blob object IDs via git ls-tree, not caller-supplied labels; the exact-head review request is regenerated from fresh judgement with content-bound review_target entries, so hand-edited or forged equivalence/review artifacts are detectable.

No connector write-channel or proof-granting code changed. Source proof provenance is read from the trusted Actions API through the existing canonical authority; the candidate cannot mint its own proof.

No writer/provenance resolution code changed. The commit is signed with the repository-declared ed25519 SSH signing key through the authorized writer channel; no author/committer alias logic was touched.
All changes are committed as one signed commit on the existing branch with no rewind or force-push; no intermediate commit lacks range evidence and no manual rewind is required.

The governed review request is regenerated at its canonical path for the exact staged head before the signed commit and verified by the finalizer; the stale PR #774 request is not reused and any later content change re-invalidates it.

Independent exact-head hostile review remains mandatory; the refreshed request records all 11 adversarial dimensions, all applicable defect families, and empty findings. This change does not claim readiness or short-circuit review.
No tri-state admission change was made. Metadata-only uncertainty returns a fail-closed refusal into a fresh full run; no merely-pending prerequisite is published as a final success by this path.

Evidence in this review is limited to identities actually implemented and exercised by committed tests; no unmet enforcement stage is claimed for any defect family, and hosted performance AFTER is explicitly marked pending.

This is the core hardened path, implemented inside the already-root-of-trust hunter_validation_reuse module: expensive hosted proof reuse requires 15 verifiable identities including Git-content tested subtree, definition, toolchain, base, exact head, run attempt, trusted job and canonical proof digest; any changed input, stale head or ambiguous evidence fails closed. Covered by the equivalence and enforcement tests.
No runtime bootstrap, volume, or issuer-composition code is touched by this diff; applicability is structural from the changed-path set only, and no bootstrap invariant is weakened.
No live-instance execution ledger, ownership, or lease code is touched; this diff cannot fail or terminally mutate another instance's active work.
No shutdown, worker-drain, or dispatcher code is touched; accepted-execution drain semantics are unchanged.
No execution ledger or preflight-ordering code is touched and this change creates no ledger claim; the canonical pre-push and hosted proof boundaries are preserved.

No workflow or validation-stage contract is modified. The candidate still passes the repository pre-push safety boundary and the full hosted exact-head Pre-PR proof; no stage is disabled or skipped by this diff.

The governed review asset is regenerated at its canonical tracked path .hunter/pre-ready-hostile-review.json and is loadable/verifiable by verify_review_request; no unloadable or character-corrupted governance path was introduced.

New tests are hermetic: equivalence/time/API behavior is driven by monkeypatched clocks and fetch functions, and subtree-digest tests read only local Git objects. No deterministic test asserts on an Issue body, remote API response, or live endpoint.
